entries.name: Soulterra
entries.content:
Soulterra is a modern fantasy world, featuring a mix of medieval and modern elements, where magic exists and powerful royal families rule with authority. Soulterra is made up of one large continent, and a scattering of islands and atolls in the oceans. It is home to 5 kingdoms and a scattering of nomadic tribes. Males only make up 20 percent of the population on this planet and are considered rare. Females are much more plentiful.
Kingdoms:
- The temperate lands of the Terre kingdom lies at the center of the continent
- The wintry lands of the Étoile kingdom lies to the north
- The lush desert lands of the Caelus kingdom lies to the south
- The ever dark badlands of the Souterraine kingdom lie to the east
- The pristine waters of the Mar kingdom lie to the west

entries.name: The Terre Kingdom
entries.content:
The Terre kingdom: Th temperate lands of the Escalón kingdom lie in the center of the continent, in a valley, surrounded by a natural barrier of towering mountains, littered with secret tunnels, whose locations are closely guarded, providing quick travel in and out of the valley. 
The Terre kingdom is the most powerful of the kingdoms, boasting the most well trained military and the second largest population of mages out of the kingdoms.
Relations: has a long standing fued with the Souterrain kingdom, but no longer pursue war with them, for fear of worsening the mana corruption of the land. Has a very close relationship with the Stellaris family and the Étoile kingdom.
Capital: the Terre kingdom's capital is the large walled city of Escalón, named for the raised layered layout of the city, making the rooftops look like 'steps'
Royal family: The Terre royal family consists of Johana Terra, the queen; Quentin Terra, the king; and Larissa Terra, the crown princess.
Magic: magic users make up 5% of the Terre kingdoms population.

entries.name: The Étoile Kingdom
entries.content:
The Étoile kingdom: home to the family of Stellaris and located to the north of the Terre kingdom. The Étoile kingdom boasts powerful magicians and amazing textiles, having just enough food to feed their people, though they do import during the coldest season.
The Étoile kingdom is feared because it has by far the largest population of mages, out numbering the population of the Terre kingdom's mages by 3 fold. The Étoile mages have little to no problem learning any kind of magic, except the Souterraine kingdom's cavern making and song weaving magics.
Capital: the location of the Étoile kingdoms capital, Isdar Mithrim is kept secret from outsiders. When visitors come from other kingdoms they are blindfolded for the duration of the trip
Relations: the Étoile kingdom is a seculeded and powerful kingdom, all but the Terre kingdom fear bringing their rage to their doorstep, The Étoile kingdom only has close relations with the Terre kingdom, with them keeping minimum contact with the Caelus kingdom to import foods during the winter.
Royal family: The Stellaris are the family of the Étoile kingdom, consisting of Loral Stellaris, the queen; Aaron Stellaris, the king; and three children that haven't been shown to anybody but the king and queen of Terre. The king, queen and children of the Stellaris family have met Larissa Terra, but are still unaware of her condition.
Magic: magic users make up 15% of the Étoile kingdoms population.

entries.name: The Caelus Kingdom
entries.content:
The Caelus kingdom: The lush desert of the Caelus kingdom lies to the south of the Terre Kingdom. The Caelus kingdom prides itself on its crystal exports and the exotic specialties native to the desert.
The Caelus kingdom has a small standing military, but largely secures it's safety through trade. Has a small population of magic users, but these magic users are capable of communicating with animals, which helps with their agriculture and ranching
Capital: The kingdom's capital, Indigo is built around the largest of the frost element crystal spires in the kingdoms desert, making the temperature warm but largely bearable year round.
Royal family: the royal family of Caelus is the house of Nimbus, little is known about the Nimbus family, and they like to keep it that way.
Magic: magic users make up 2% of the Caelus kingdoms population.

entries.name: The Mar Kingdom
entries.content:
The Mar kingdom: The pristine waters of the Mar kingdom lie to the west of the Terre Kingdom. The Mar kingdom prides itself on it's thriving maritime economy and exotic sea exports. A large part of it's territory is made up of lakes and rivers giving it the second least amount of land territory on the continent.
The Mar kingdom has a large fleet of warships, directed and manned by the most skilled saliors in Soulterra, Mar has a decent population of magic users, these magic users have found a way to make bubbles of air under their lakes and rivers, using this magic they make up for the lack of dry land. 
Capital: the capital of the Mar kingdom, Atlantis, is located in a bubble under the ocean and has ports and shipyards on the shore that extends out of the ocean.
Royal family: the royal family of the Mar kingdom is the house of Unda, the Unda family consists of Delmar Unda, the king; Lucille Unda, the queen and 2 children that have yet to make a public appearance.
Magic: magic users make up 3% of the Mar kingdoms population.

entries.name: The Souterraine Kingdom
entries.content:
The Souterraine kingdom: The ever dark badlands of the Souterraine kingdom lie to the east of the Terre kingdom. The Souterraine kingdom is located almost entirely underground due to the harsh nature of the badlands and the dark mana abundant on the surface. The kingdom boasts great miners and most amazing smiths in all the kingdoms. Due to the harshness of their territory they import a lot of food from the other kingdoms.
The souterraine kingdom has no standing military to speak of and a sparse population of magic users, they are still largely in remission from the aftermath of their 20 year long war with the Terre kingdom, what magic they do have is capable of shaping entire caverns, and singing magic into metals, weaving spells into their crafts.
Capital: the Souterraine kingdom's capital, Umberum, is located in a massive ravine in the middle of the badlands, the ravine walls are covered in gemstones and mana crystals, making any magical scrying or spying near impossible.
Royal family: the royal family of the souterraine kingdom is the house of Tenebris, the Tenebris family has been  staying hidden for the last 5 years since the end of the war.
Magic: magic users make up less than 0.1% of the Souterraine kingdoms population.

entries.name: Magic
entries.content: Magic is largely uncommon among the population on Soulterra. Each of the royal families has a magic they specialize in. Mysteriously the Escalón royal family is the only one of the royal families that doesn't use any magic.
